items.name: Biofrontera
items.status: NEW TOP MONDAY FDA / PDUFA BINARY
items.trigger: $1.23 Friday high only if decision has not hit; after FDA news use post-decision break-and-hold/retest
items.invalidation: $1.16 Friday low pre-decision; post-news support/VWAP failure TBD
items.note: Clean-slate scan surfaced a Monday Sep 28 FDA PDUFA decision for Ameluz PDT label expansion into superficial basal cell carcinoma. If approved, company says it would be the first and only PDT photosensitizer indicated for sBCC in the U.S. Friday closed about $1.18 on ~248K shares, below average volume, so catalyst quality is exceptional but momentum/executability are weaker than KOD/ACET/AIFF. Treat as binary FDA risk; do not chase the first headline spike.
